upheld.detail: TC-BUG-47-01 repeats the empty foreign-order 404 coverage in TC-BUG-47-03 and the owner-access coverage in TC-BUG-47-04. Its private-field assertions add no protection after asserting an empty body.
upheld.requirement: Council Useless tests: report tests repeating existing coverage without a new branch.

upheld.title: Unit tests do not verify the caller's id is passed to the order query
upheld.detail: Both updated OrdersWebApiTest cases stub GetOrderAsync with Arg.Any<string>(), so a regression where the endpoint passes null or a wrong id instead of IdentityService.GetUserIdentity() would still pass the unit suite; only the test-stack e2e spec guards the security fix.
upheld.requirement: Step 3 answers 404 with no order data ... alice still gets her own order (200)
